statement: The weight-one contravariant functor is asserted fully faithful. For abelian schemes, generic rational h¹ morphisms and all integral lattice conditions recover generic homomorphisms; already-existing generic homomorphisms extend over a normal base. Disconnected component extensions require their own argument.
computation: proofs.md §10
fate: Faltings1986§2Lemma1 proves extension of generic homomorphisms between already-existing semiabelian schemes over a normal base. Tate1966 proves finite-field integral full faithfulness for one prime. These are ingredients, not a proof that all disconnected-group systems lie in the essential image.
present_status: As of 2026-11-19: Abelian-scheme morphism ingredient established; exact entire source functor remains conditional on rational motives and component data.

fate: Vasiu–Zink2010Theorem28 gives regular local rings R=W(k)[[x,y]]/(p−(xy)^{p−1}) whose punctured spectra carry nonextendable abelian schemes. statement: An F-linear additive idempotent-complete category whose endomorphism algebra of every object is finite-dimensional semisimple is semisimple abelian.
computation: General proof in proofs.md §12 plus exact rectangular certificate.
fate: Jannsen1992Lemma2 states the exact criterion. The independent proof uses Artin–Wedderburn decomposition of End(X⊕Y), constructs generalized inverses in matrix corners, and then kernels/cokernels; it does not assume abelianness at the circular-sounding source phrase.
present_status: As of 2026-11-19: Established abstract theorem. Applying it to homological motives still needs the missing semisimplicity hypothesis; numerical motives satisfy JannsenTheorem1. October2026 preprints and Milne’s9November report announce stronger abelian subcases (CM Hodge/generalized Hodge, finite-field abelian Tate, abelian Hodge-standard); see2026_abelian_status.md for exact scope and proof-review limits.
